ru_RU.title: bilibili - Anime · Video HD
ru_RU.description:
🎬 Welcome to bilibili – the ultimate home for anime fans, gamers, tech geeks, and culture lovers.

Ever dreamed of a place where you could binge anime edits, watch live esports with 10,000 danmu (bullet comments), and explore street food from across the globe—all in a single afternoon?

That's what we do here.

We're bilibili. We watch, we laugh, we remix, we overthink, and then we create again.

Whatever you're into—we've got it.
🎮 Hardcore into gaming?
From competitive esports to chill strategy Let's Plays, we've got gameplay videos, walkthroughs, speedruns, and rage quits galore.
🤖 Love cool gadgets and tech?
Dive into in-depth unboxings, honest reviews, or sci-fi concepts brought to life.
🎨 Obsessed with anime and fandoms?
This is your paradise—AMVs, cosplay tutorials, parody dubs, and wild fan theories included.
🌍 Into global culture?
Explore music, performing arts, creative writing, and street food from all over the world. Here, culture is binged just like a series.
💡 Hear creators in your language
With our new AI Dubbing feature, you can enjoy creators from around the world without needing subtitles. Fewer language barriers, more "I get you."
Your passion deserves a stage. Or at least a fanbase. 🚀
Got a hot take? A crazy remix idea? A cosplay transformation to show off? This is your space.

Everyone here is a creator in the making—drawing, dubbing, animating, narrating, memeing, and constantly inventing something new. From "fan" to "creator," you're just one upload away.

✨ We're not just a video app.

We're a creative community where culture meets fandom, memes meet meaning, and your interests meet their tribe.

We'll see you in the danmu. Or maybe on the Trending tab 😉

– With creativity & culture,

The bilibili team 💙💗
ru_RU.changelog: We made some improvements and squashed a few bugs.
